voiceSelection: Authorized Joan of Arc campaign narrator clone

paragraphs: Frankish Paladins are dependable all-rounders, with extra health that helps them stay in the fight.
Teutonic Paladins use extra melee armor to absorb punishment and trade blows, giving them an edge in many close-range fights.
With four relics, Lithuanian Paladins hit hard enough to dispatch fragile units quickly and punch through heavily armored opponents.
The Persian Savar excels against ranged armies, combining strong pierce armor with extra damage against archers.
